m365.title: Before these fields work: register an app in Azure
m365.intro: Microsoft 365 sign-in needs an app registration in Azure. You do this once, it takes about five minutes, and afterwards every user can connect their own account.
m365.step1: Open {portal} and choose “New registration”. Any name works, for example “Synaplan”.
m365.step2: Under “Redirect URI”, pick the platform type Web (not SPA) and paste this address exactly:
m365.step3: Go to “API permissions” → “Add a permission” → “Microsoft Graph” → “Delegated permissions” and add all of these:
m365.step3Note: offline_access is not optional: without it Microsoft issues no refresh token and every scheduled run stops working after an hour.
m365.step4: Go to “Certificates & secrets” → “New client secret” and copy the Value column — not the Secret ID. It is shown only this once.
m365.step5: Paste the client ID and the secret into the fields below, set the tenant, and switch M365_ENABLED on. Users then connect their own account under Channels → Connections.
m365.ready: Ready — users can connect their Microsoft 365 account under Channels → Connections.
m365.notReady: Not active yet. Fill in the fields below and switch M365_ENABLED on.
m365.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.

dropbox.title: Before these fields work: create an app in the Dropbox App Console
dropbox.intro: The Dropbox connection needs a Dropbox app. You do this once, it takes about five minutes, and afterwards every user can connect their own account.
dropbox.step1: Open the {console} and choose “Create app”. Pick “Scoped access” and “Full Dropbox”. Any name works, for example “Synaplan”.
dropbox.step2: On the “Permissions” tab, enable both of these and click “Submit”:
dropbox.step3: On the “Settings” tab, under “OAuth 2 → Redirect URIs”, add this address exactly:
dropbox.step4: Still on the “Settings” tab, copy the App key and the App secret (click “Show”).
dropbox.step5: Paste the app key and the secret into the fields below and switch DROPBOX_ENABLED on. Users then connect their own account under Channels → Connections.

dropbox.notReady: Not active yet. Fill in the fields below and switch DROPBOX_ENABLED on.

fields.MEDIA_ASYNC_JOBS_ENABLED: Run image, video and audio generation in the background so chat is never blocked. The assistant shows a live status and a toast when it finishes. When off, the turn waits until the file is ready. Needs the worker container.
fields.COMPUTE_ENABLED: Let the assistant do short file work (Python or Node) on copies of files you chose. Needs the compute sidecar (COMPUTE_URL + COMPUTE_TOKEN). A local docker compose up starts that sidecar and turns this on.
fields.COMPUTE_REQUIRE_TIER: Minimum isolation the sidecar must report before file work turns on: Standard (plain Docker), Strong isolation (gVisor), or Virtual machine (microVM). Synaplan Cloud requires Strong isolation.
fields.COMPUTE_WORKSPACES_ENABLED: Keep a folder between file-work runs so the assistant can continue earlier work. Files → Workspace shows what is in it. Also needs file work itself to be on.
fields.COMPUTE_EGRESS_ENABLED: Let a file-work run fetch from a short list of public websites the assistant named. Off by default — runs stay offline. Private or local addresses are always refused. Can only be switched on when the sidecar offers website access.
fields.COMPUTE_EGRESS_REQUIRES_APPROVAL: When a run will fetch from the web, ask the owner first even if everyday file work would run automatically. On by default.
fields.COMPUTE_EGRESS_MAX_HOSTS: How many websites one file-work run may list. Default 8.
fields.COMPUTE_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SEC: Default seconds a file-work run may take.
fields.COMPUTE_DEFAULT_MEMORY_MB: Default memory cap in megabytes for a file-work run.
fields.COMPUTE_DEFAULT_CPU: Default CPU share for a file-work run.
fields.COMPUTE_DEFAULT_PIDS: Default process cap for a file-work run.
fields.COMPUTE_DEFAULT_OUTPUT_MB: Default size cap in megabytes for files the run may create.
fields.COMPUTE_MAX_TIMEOUT_SEC: Hard ceiling in seconds for a file-work run.
fields.COMPUTE_POLICY_INTERACTIVE: When the owner is present (chat or a live API call): run file work automatically, ask first, or never run it. An assistant cannot loosen this.
fields.COMPUTE_POLICY_UNATTENDED: When a saved task runs file work on its own: ask the owner first (default), run automatically, or never run it. An assistant cannot loosen this.
fields.COMPUTE_WORKSPACE_TTL_DAYS: How many days a file-work folder may sit unused before cleanup can remove it. Default 90.

groq.title: Groq API key
groq.message: Create a free Groq API key in the Groq console, then paste it here. The free tier is usually enough to start chatting in under a minute.

openai.title: OpenAI API key
openai.message: Create an API key in your OpenAI account (API keys page), then paste it here. Usage is billed by OpenAI.

anthropic.title: Anthropic API key
anthropic.message: Create an API key in the Anthropic console (Settings → Keys), then paste it here to use Claude models.

google.title: Google Gemini API key
google.message: Create a Gemini API key in Google AI Studio, then paste it here. A free tier is available for many models.

mistral.title: Mistral API key
mistral.message: Create an API key in the Mistral console, then paste it here. Mistral offers a free tier for getting started.

trustedtokens.title: TrustedTokens API key
trustedtokens.message: Create an API key at TrustedTokens (Account → API Access), then paste it here. Inference runs on German GPUs with EU data residency.

a2agent.title: A2Agent API key
a2agent.message: Create a pay-as-you-go API key at A2Agent (dashboard → API keys), then paste it here. Prompts are processed by mainland-China model vendors (Qwen, DeepSeek, MiniMax) through this gateway. A2Agent serves users outside mainland China. Operators handling EU personal data should decide per their DPA.

meta.title: Meta API key
meta.message: Create an API key in the Meta Model API dashboard (API keys), then paste it here. This unlocks Muse Spark. Prompts are processed by Meta.

huggingface.title: HuggingFace API token
huggingface.message: Create an access token in your HuggingFace settings, then paste it here to use HuggingFace Inference models.

xai.title: xAI API key
xai.message: Create an API key in the xAI console, then paste it here to use Grok models.

perplexity.title: Perplexity API key
perplexity.message: Create an API key in your Perplexity account, then paste it here to use Sonar models. The same key is used for web search if you pick Perplexity on the Web search tab.

ollama.title: Local AI with Ollama
ollama.message: Download Ollama and pull a capable model such as gpt-oss:120b (or a smaller one like llama3.2 if your machine has less RAM). No API key is needed — Synaplan talks to Ollama at the configured URL.
